scientific_integrity: The claim is established by an explicit finite-fiber phase reduction, rational interval union, and coalescence argument. The exact-rational checker tests finite examples and does not replace the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: One connected one-sided interval barrier, two-square noninvertible model, and reduced rational positive slope. Area results exclude a null family of boundary orbits and use unit-horizontal-advance time. The known irrational recurrent-area theorem is cited, not reproved. Equivalent external formulations may exist.
title: Rational-direction area resonance and uniform capture clocks for a one-sided two-square flow
